author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a box with a slanted loop inside that read as a wallet or paperclip, with no hands visible. Now a 45-degree clasp between two open shirt sleeves: the right hand's back runs into a thumb with a rounded tip over the left hand, and the left hand's heel drops into two scalloped fingertips with a knuckle line, then an index edge up to the right cuff.
omissions: third fingertip and finger outlines (8-unit spacing along the 45-degree chain)
